states.label: Pre-Auth
states.explanation: Anonymous auth channels reject malformed non-empty encrypted tenantIds (422 InvalidId) and apply .IgnoreQueryFilters() with explicit !IsDeleted, tenant, active, and lockout guards.

states.label: Verify
states.explanation: PasswordHasher validates versioned $s2$ hashes (SHA-256 pre-hash + BCrypt wf 12), breached-password denylist (8,616 entries), PasswordHistory (0-24, default 5), and LoginLockoutThreshold (5).

states.label: MFA Gate
states.explanation: HybridMfaPolicy suppresses session tokens and issues a single-use 5-minute TwoFactorPendingToken. TOTP/backup checks serialize via TwoFactorAttemptLockHelper.

states.label: Policy Wall
states.explanation: ISessionIssuerService evaluates MustChangePassword (mcp=true) strictly before RequireMfaEnrollment (mfa_enroll=true); stages 23-25 enforce TrustedCidr, MustChangePasswordMiddleware, and RequireMfaEnrollmentMiddleware.

states.label: Session
states.explanation: SessionIssuerService binds 30m default HS256 JWT (JTI + scripe_iat_ms), BrandingSettings HttpOnly refresh cookie, MaxConcurrentSessions oldest-first eviction, and StaySignedIn vs SessionTimeoutMinutes.

states.label: Revoked
states.explanation: Logout, password change, StopImpersonation, or revocation stamps IAccountRevocationCache (MarkRevokedAsync +5ms cutoff), blacklists JTI in Redis, revokes refresh families, and clears HttpOnly cookies.

states.label: Reset Grant
states.explanation: OtpService stores HMAC-SHA256 verifiers (Verification:VerifierKey, 5 max attempts, 10m/30m Prod). verify-reset-otp emits single-use ResetGrantToken; reset-password revokes all sessions and returns 204 without auto-login.

states.label: Locked Out
states.explanation: Exceeding LoginLockoutThreshold locks admin/user sign-ins for LoginLockoutMinutes (default 15m) with uniform error signaling and Redis-backed rate limits.

states.label: Ceiling Hit
states.explanation: AbsoluteExpiresAt hard-caps every refresh family: 24h for non-persistent sessions, Max(refreshDays*4, 30)d for StaySignedIn, and non-extendable 8h for impersonation.

cards.title: Ordered Post-Login Gates & Session Bounds
items: Authentication proceeds strictly: Primary Factor -> Hybrid MFA (TwoFactorPendingToken) -> MustChangePassword (mcp=true) -> RequireMfaEnrollment (mfa_enroll=true)
ISessionIssuerService computes Access JWT (30m default), rolling refresh, and immutable AbsoluteExpiresAt caps (24h, >=30d persistent, 8h impersonation)

cards.title: No Auto-Login Recovery & Instant Revocation
items: Password reset emits ResetGrantToken from verify-reset-otp and returns 204 No Content on reset-password so users re-authenticate cleanly
Account lockouts (5 attempts / 15m), MaxConcurrentSessions eviction, JTI blacklist, StopImpersonation revocation checks, and +5ms MarkRevokedAsync enforce fail-closed cutoff
